title: Tripadvisor Hotel Availability Response
description: The response payload returned by a partner's availability endpoint when Tripadvisor checks hotel pricing and room availability in real-time via the Hotel Availability Check (HAC) API v8.

api_version.description: The API version number of this response.

hotels.description: Array of hotel availability results, one per requested hotel.

errors.description: Array of errors encountered during the availability check.

HotelAvailability.description: Availability and pricing information for a single hotel property.

hotel_id.description: The partner's internal hotel ID matching the request.

availability.description: The availability status for this hotel.

room_types.description: Map from room type keys to room type objects. Must include an entry for every unique room_type_key used in room_rates.

room_rates.description: Map from room rate keys to room rate objects containing pricing details.

url.description: Deep link URL to the partner's booking page for this hotel.

RoomType.description: A room type available at the hotel.

url.description: Deep link URL to the booking page for this room type.

description.description: A description of the room type.

room_type_code.description: Persistent room type code that identifies this room type across requests.

photos.description: Array of photos for this room type.

url.description: URL of the room type photo.

caption.description: Caption for the room type photo.

amenities.description: Array of amenity names available in this room type.

max_occupancy.description: The maximum number of guests for this room type.

RoomRate.description: Pricing details for a specific room rate.

room_type_key.description: Key referencing the room type this rate applies to.

rate_plan_code.description: Persistent rate plan code identifying this rate across requests.

url.description: Deep link URL to book at this rate.

line_items.description: Array of line item objects for rate, tax, and fee breakdowns.

occupancy.description: The number of guests this rate is for.

meal_plan.description: The meal plan included with this rate.

LineItem.description: A pricing line item representing a rate, tax, or fee component.

sub_type.description: The sub-type providing more detail about the line item.

price.description: The monetary amount for this line item.

paid_at_checkout.description: Whether this amount is paid at checkout rather than at booking time.

CancellationRules.description: Cancellation policy rules for a room rate with time-windowed penalties.

rules.description: Array of cancellation rule periods with associated penalties.

start.description: The start date-time of this cancellation policy window.

end.description: The end date-time of this cancellation policy window.

penalty_amount.description: The penalty amount charged if cancelled during this period.

penalty_currency.description: The currency of the penalty amount.

AvailabilityError.description: An error encountered for a specific hotel during the availability check.

hotel_id.description: The partner hotel ID that experienced the error.

message.description: A human-readable error message describing what went wrong.
